card.name: Guaracha
card.profile: The guaracha is a Cuban genre of rapid tempo with comic, picaresque or satirical lyrics, documented since the late 18th/early 19th century. Played in musical theatres and working-class dance salons, it became integral to bufo comic theatre by the mid-19th century and was a favourite in Havana's brothels around 1900. Accompanied by guitar and tres (later by conjuntos and big bands), it uses soloist-coro call-and-response, combinations of 6/8 with 2/4, and slang-filled topical lyrics. It survives in trova, conjunto and salsa repertoires (English Wikipedia; Smithsonian).
card.insight: During the 19th-century independence struggle, the bufo theatre's guarachas served as a political weapon, lampooning Spanish authorities and supporting Cuban independence (English Wikipedia).
